```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(arrow)
```

```{r}
arrow::open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet")$schema
```

```{r}
arrow::open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  slice_sample(n = 10) |>
  collect() |>
  as_tibble()
```

```{r}
arrow::open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  filter(date_raw >= "2025-01-01") |>
  group_by(coin_id) |>
  summarize(avg_market_cap = mean(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  arrange(desc(avg_market_cap)) |>
  collect() |>
  as_tibble()
```

```{r}
arrow::open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  collect() |>
  arrow::write_dataset("data/prices_by_coin", partitioning = "coin_id")
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
prices <- arrow::open_dataset("data/daily_prices.parquet") |>
  collect() |>
  as_tibble()

metadata <- arrow::open_dataset("data/coin_metadata.parquet") |>
  collect() |>
  as_tibble()

categories <- arrow::open_dataset("data/categories.parquet") |>
  collect() |>
  as_tibble()

crypto <- prices |>
  left_join(metadata, by = "coin_id") |>
  left_join(
    categories |>
      rename(category_description = description),
    by = "category_id"
  ) |>
  mutate(date = lubridate::ymd(date_raw)) |>
  as_tibble()
```

```{r}
prices |>
  filter(coin_id == "btc") |>
  mutate(date = lubridate::ymd(date_raw)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = price_usd)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Bitcoin Daily Price",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Price (USD)"
  )
```

```{r}
prices |>
  filter(coin_id == "btc") |>
  mutate(date = lubridate::ymd(date_raw)) |>
  mutate(market_cap_trillions = market_cap_usd / 1e12) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = market_cap_trillions)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Bitcoin Market Cap Over Time",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Market Cap (Trillions USD)"
  )
```

```{r}
# Calculate median market cap per coin for ordering
coin_order <- prices |>
  mutate(market_cap_billions = market_cap_usd / 1e9) |>
  group_by(coin_id) |>
  summarize(median_market_cap = median(market_cap_billions, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  arrange(desc(median_market_cap)) |>
  pull(coin_id)

prices |>
  mutate(
    market_cap_billions = market_cap_usd / 1e9,
    coin_id = factor(coin_id, levels = coin_order)
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = coin_id, y = market_cap_billions)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "Market Cap Distribution Across 22 Coins",
    x = "Coin",
    y = "Market Cap (Billions USD, log scale)"
  ) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
crypto |>
  group_by(date) |>
  summarize(total_market_cap = sum(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  mutate(total_market_cap_trillions = total_market_cap / 1e12) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = date, y = total_market_cap_trillions)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Total Cryptocurrency Market Cap",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Market Cap (Trillions USD)"
  )
```

```{r}
crypto |>
  group_by(date, category_name) |>
  summarize(category_market_cap = sum(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  mutate(category_market_cap_trillions = category_market_cap / 1e12) |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = date,
      y = category_market_cap_trillions,
      color = category_name
    )
  ) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Cryptocurrency Market Cap by Category",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Market Cap (Trillions USD)",
    color = "Category"
  )
```

```{r}
category_order <- crypto |>
  group_by(date, category_name) |>
  summarize(
    category_market_cap = sum(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  group_by(category_name) |>
  summarize(
    typical_market_cap = median(category_market_cap, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(typical_market_cap)) |>
  pull(category_name)

event_windows <- tibble(
  event = c("Luna/UST crash", "FTX collapse"),
  start = as.Date(c("2022-05-07", "2022-11-08")),
  end = as.Date(c("2022-05-12", "2022-11-11"))
)

crypto |>
  group_by(date, category_name) |>
  summarize(
    category_market_cap = sum(market_cap_usd, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  group_by(date) |>
  mutate(
    category_share = category_market_cap / sum(category_market_cap),
    category_name = factor(category_name, levels = category_order)
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  arrange(category_name, date) |>
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x = date,
      y = category_share,
      fill = category_name,
      group = category_name
    )
  ) +
  geom_rect(
    data = event_windows,
    aes(xmin = start, xmax = end, ymin = 0, ymax = 1),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "grey20",
    alpha = 0.12
  ) +
  geom_area() +
  geom_text(
    data = event_windows,
    aes(x = start, y = 0.96, label = event),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 1,
    angle = 90,
    size = 3
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "D", end = 0.9) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_percent()
  ) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Cryptocurrency Market Cap Shares by Category",
    subtitle = "Each band shows a category's share of total cryptocurrency market capitalization on each day.",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Share of Total Market Cap",
    fill = "Category",
    caption = "Source: Cryptocurrency daily prices, coin metadata, and category data."
  )
```
